title: [IMP-28] Required test vectors do not exist and several constructions have none planned
description: Review finding IMP-28: Required test vectors do not exist and several constructions have none planned (lens IMP). Location: spec/13-encoding.md:84-86 (not :148-150). Fix: The missing JWS vector set is already tracked ("Open (agora-pozi.20.16)", 13:86), so it is not new. The new part is that no vectors are planned for the exporter, HKDF, AEAD-layout and CID constructions. Missing vectors do not themselves cause divergence: the ambiguities are counted under IMP-2/5/6/13. Add a §13.4 vector requirement once those are fixed. Full text: notes/review/IMP-verified.md and notes/review/IMP.md.
